# OpenClaw skill fixtures — provenance

Verbatim, unmodified copies of real published OpenClaw `SKILL.md` files, used as
parser/loader test fixtures. **Do not edit these files.** They are third-party
content reproduced byte-for-byte, including invalid or nonstandard frontmatter —
that irregularity is the point of the fixture. To refresh one, re-fetch from the
pinned URL below rather than hand-editing.

Each row records the exact commit-pinned raw URL the file was fetched from, plus a
`sha256` of the bytes as stored here. Every file was fetched twice over two
independent transports (the GitHub contents API and `raw.githubusercontent.com`)
and the digests matched.

Fetched: 2026-07-30 — 26 skills.
